training_config.selection_policy: Hyperparameters are tuned with 5-fold stratified cross-validation on the training partition only (scoring = macro F1). The test set is untouched during tuning. All three tuned models are then evaluated once on the same held-out test set, and the model with the highest held-out macro F1 is selected (ties broken by accuracy, then by cross-validation score).

decision_tree.name: Decision Tree
decision_tree.summary: A single decision tree that splits the data on threshold questions such as 'is rainfall above 150 mm?'. It is easy to visualise and explain, but a single tree can overfit the training data.

random_forest.name: Random Forest
random_forest.summary: An ensemble (bag) of many decision trees whose votes are pooled. Averaging many decorrelated trees usually reduces the overfitting of a single tree at the cost of a larger, less transparent model.

svm.name: Support Vector Machine (SVM)
svm.summary: A Support Vector Machine finds decision boundaries that separate the crop classes with the widest margin. It is wrapped in a StandardScaler pipeline because SVM is sensitive to feature scale.
